tytul: Chokeberry juice with cherry leaves: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for chokeberry (aronia) juice made with cherry leaves to make it less astringent.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to Oregon State University Extension, writing about herb and flower jellies, a tea made from herbs or flowers is likely not acidic enough to prevent pathogen growth; to be canned, it needs a tested amount of added acid, sugar or both, even when the tea is strained.

If the juice is made in a steam juicer: UC warns that pouring the juice straight into sterilized jars, capping them and storing them at room temperature without further processing (“bottling”) is not safe; the juice must be canned by recommendations consistent with NCHFP.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no checked source on whether cherry leaves are safe to add to juice.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for chokeberry juice with cherry leaves from a checked source.
